instruction: I want to protect my privacy by removing all Google cookies from my browser. Please delete all tracking cookies that Google has stored so they can't follow my online activities.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to delete cookies from Google. Uses existing getter 'get_cookie_data' and metric 'is_cookie_deleted' with domain-based checking. The evaluator verifies that no cookies from .google.com domain remain after the task is completed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_cookie_data' correctly extracts all cookies from Chrome's SQLite database, including domain information needed for verification
Metric 'is_cookie_deleted' correctly checks if any cookies from .google.com domain remain by iterating through cookie domains and using compare_urls for matching
Expected value '.google.com' is semantically correct for matching Google cookies (including subdomains like www.google.com)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure cookie database is saved and can be read in fresh state
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the core requirement that no Google cookies remain after deletion
Logic handles edge cases correctly: empty cookie data, subdomain matching, and allows non-Google cookies to remain
